raw:
@a1 assumed
  relation "receive the merit scholarship"
  role subject "not all from group 1032"
  polarity affirmed
  basis implicature

@q query
  select ?x
  where all
    match
      relation "be in"
      role subject ?x
      role object "group 1032"
      polarity affirmed
    end
    match
      relation "receive the merit scholarship"
      role subject ?x
      polarity negated
    end
  end
